name: Transportation Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public transportation data.

entries.title: FRA Railroad Safety Data
entries.description: The Federal Railroad Administration's railroad safety data — train accidents, highway-rail grade crossing incidents and inventory, casualties, trespasser data, and operational data — as reports and full downloadable datasets.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Transportation, Federal Railroad Administration (FRA)
entries.attribution: Federal Railroad Administration, Office of Railroad Safety
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 ("Last update: Friday, October 30, 2026"). The page announces a new FRA safety data page, released in December 2024, with "reports, full datasets, and PDF reports for train accident, highway-rail crossing incident, highway-rail crossing inventory, casualty, and operational data". It lists Full Datasets and Data Downloads for each category. The FRA main site (railroads.dot.gov) returned 403 to curl. The monthly cadence and the csv format are assumed and weren't checked. A steward may want to repoint canonical_url to the new safety data page.

entries.title: UNCTADstat
entries.description: UN Trade and Development's statistical database covering maritime transport, merchant fleets, liner shipping connectivity, and freight volumes alongside its broader trade and economy indicators.
entries.publisher: United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). ITF-OECD (International Transport Forum), the other natural international transport-statistics body, returned a Cloudflare bot-challenge on direct fetch — same block class as almanac-template#2. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.
